title: Fix Agent Chat 'chat drives the stage' e2e oracle: stub re-emits tool call every step → 24 rects, asserts 1 (FAILS)
description:
FIXED. 1284 did NOT resolve the re-emit problem — diagnostic e2e at HEAD confirmed delta=24, chips=24 still (stub re-emitted stage_add_shape on every doStream step). The spec only 'passed' because expect.poll(countShapes).toBe(before+1) caught a TRANSIENT count of 1 mid-storm (flaky), not a settled single-action turn.

ROOT CAUSE unchanged: testStub.ts makeStubRunTurn's doStream emitted the tool call unconditionally every step → AI SDK loop ran to stepCountIs(MAX_STEPS=24) cap → 24 dispatches.

FIX (packages/authoring-ui/src/agentchat/testStub.ts): track a stepIndex in the closure. Step 0 emits the scripted text + tool call(s) with finishReason:'tool-calls'; subsequent step(s), after the tool result is in context, emit a final plain-text answer ('Done.') + finishReason:'stop' and NO tool-call, so the loop terminates after exactly one tool round. Still drives the REAL buildAgentTools→dispatchAgentCommand path; only the model is mocked.

SPEC HARDENED (apps/desktop/e2e/agent-chat-drives-stage.spec.ts): replaced the transient-prone expect.poll with a deterministic settle (wait for agent-stop to disappear / agent-send to reappear = loop reached terminal stop), then assert EXACTLY-ONE: countShapes == before+1 (settled, not >before) AND agent-tool-chip toHaveCount(1). This proves one-and-only-one dispatch.

GUARD PROVEN: temporarily forcing the buggy re-emit (isFirstStep=true) made the spec FAIL 'Expected: 1 / Received: 24' — the old polling assertion had passed the same buggy stub. Reverted.

VERIFY (all in worktree):
- pnpm --filter @flash/desktop e2e -- agent-chat-drives-stage: 6/6 passed (--repeat-each=6), deterministic.
- pnpm --filter @flash/authoring-ui run test -- --run: 765/765 passed (0 failures).
- pnpm --filter './packages/**' build: clean (all 7 packages Done).

Vite aliases @flash/authoring-ui→src, so the e2e exercises the source fix directly.
